Subject: Kick off MAP for Dedicated GPU pool (CleverFin)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the performance numbers looked promising. Our infra team asked me to get a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) started so we can align on throughput targets, timelines, and the stakeholders who will run the GPU pool once provisioned. High level ask: we want to commit to a pilot and be production-ready for a 100 QPS/100k token-day workload by end of Q3.

Can you put together a short kickoff email that lists:
- Redwood stakeholders and their roles for this MAP
- The evaluation plan and pass/fail criteria (latency P95, tokens/sec, error budget)
- A recommended close timeline and any blockers you expect (SOC2 evidence, procurement)

Also looping in Alex (cc) from our engineering team.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Goldberg
Head of ML Infrastructure, CleverFin

Hi Sara, Alex — great to hear the demo was useful. I’ve sketched a concise MAP kickoff below and attached our editable MAP template and initial throughput targets PDF. Please review and tell me if you want the pilot target adjusted.

Quick kickoff summary (proposed):
- Redwood MAP lead: Sofia Ivanova (sales/solutions) — single point for MAP coordination and runbooks.
- Account executive / negotiation: Marissa Cole — pricing, contract milestones, and PO coordination.
- Dedicated capacity owner (technical): Karthik Iyer (inference infra) — responsible for GPU pool sizing, autoscaling policies, and benchmarks.
- Customer success / onboarding: Monica Patel — onboarding plan, runbook handover, and health checks post-go-live.

Evaluation plan (pilot):
- Scope: dedicated GPU pool (NVIDIA H100-class or equivalent), model: ops-llama-70b-q3 variant, steady-state test window = 30 minutes.
- Pass criteria: P95 latency < 250 ms for 2k token requests, sustained throughput >= 100 QPS for 1 minute, overall error rate < 0.5%.
- Metrics and artifacts: server-side traces, token-level cost estimate, KV cache hit rate, benchmark script + raw logs.

Proposed timeline (conservative):
- Week 0 (kickoff) — agree MAP, assign stakeholders, finalize contract terms (1 week).
- Weeks 1–2 — Dedicated pool provisioning & baseline benchmark (env ready, smoke tests).
- Weeks 3–4 — Pilot evaluation and optimization (batching/quantization tweaks).
- End of Week 5 — Go/no-go decision, close (roll to reserved capacity or iterate).

Potential blockers: procurement lead time for reserved capacity, SOC2 evidence requests for private deployment (if required), and any cross-region latency trials.

I attached: "CleverFin_MAP_template_v1.xlsx" (editable MAP with milestones) and "throughput_targets_v1.pdf" (initial load profile and proposed GPU counts).

Action items:
- Sara: confirm pilot target (100 QPS / 100k token-day) or propose adjusted SLOs.
- Alex: share any existing benchmark scripts or preferred test harness.
- Marissa/Ben: I’ll hand over to Marissa for contracting once we confirm targets.

Happy to set a 30-min sync later this week to run through the MAP live.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: CleverFin_MAP_template_v1.xlsx; throughput_targets_v1.pdf
